revision_rule: NOTHING here may be revised after any confirmatory fold runs. Anything re-specified from a control arm is labelled derived_from_control_arm and is NOT pre-registration.

cpu_reference.NOT_THE_GRID_SOURCE: the CPU/fp32 grid was 0.010045/0.050225/0.200901 and was NOT swept; Stage-2 brief 1 forbids hashing it as the grid's provenance

provenance.section_7_7_note: a +27.6% move in the BNM/CE step-0 gradient ratio between CPU/fp32 and T4/fp16 is a 7.7 data point: results are not portable across architectures at this precision.

remeasurement.WHAT_THIS_IS: A SECOND, LATER MEASUREMENT. It is NOT the provenance of the gamma grid that was swept. The original T4/fp16 run's session was lost before its file was downloaded, so the grid's true provenance is UNRECOVERABLE and this pre-registration says so rather than substituting a lookalike.
remeasurement.WHAT_THE_SWEEP_ACTUALLY_USED: the ORIGINAL measurement, whose ratio is known only by back-computation from the swept grid: 12.7062. gamma = 0.00787 was selected under that grid and REMAINS SELECTED. The grid is NOT re-derived from this file.
remeasurement.what_exact_regeneration_does_and_does_no: DOES: the second measurement, put through the same formula and the same 6-dp rounding, returns the identical grid -- so the swept grid is reproducible on this architecture and precision, and the numbers Stage 2 used were not a one-off artifact of a lost run. That is the strongest corroboration available short of the original file. DOES NOT: restore provenance. This is still a different run from the one that produced the grid, the original remains lost, and the grid is still not re-derived from this file.
remeasurement.interpretation: NOT MATERIAL. The re-measurement agrees with the back-computed ratio inside the declared 5%, which is consistent with fp16 reduction-order nondeterminism and adds no 7.7 finding. It corroborates the swept grid without being its provenance.
remeasurement.what_this_does_NOT_license: it does not license re-deriving the grid, re-selecting gamma, or describing the swept grid as having verified provenance. The grid's own measurement is gone and stays gone in this record.

provenance.if_the_file_is_unrecoverable: re-run --measure-step0 on T4/fp16 and record it as a SECOND, LATER measurement -- never as the provenance for the grid already swept. Report both numbers, disclose that the sweep used the first, and treat any material difference as a WITHIN-ARCHITECTURE variance data point for 7.7. DO NOT re-derive the grid from the new file.

gamma.basis: the smaller of the passing arms (7.15's winner's curse)
gamma.criterion: (1) ||A||_* moves >= 0.1 from init 9.7704; (2) pred-pos frac >= the GATING floor 0.0292 -- the 0.75 ceiling is ADVISORY and never selects; (3) the frozen probe retains >= half its headroom over chance
gamma.extension_rule: if none passes, multiply the TOP gamma by 4 (the grid's own spacing) and re-run; at most 1 extension

cadence.statistics_only_property: sub-grid points record the nuclear norm, mean prediction entropy, predicted-positive fraction and the 704/78 split ONLY. No TPR, no AUROC, no evaluation of any kind. Enforced BY CONSTRUCTION: run_bnm_r6.stats_only_row does not take the scorer as an argument, so it cannot score even by mistake. test_bnm_round6.T19 asserts the signature, then the tokenised body, with the full path as the known-null.
cadence.why_the_250_grid_is_untouched: every 250-multiple keeps its full evaluation, so the Task-A decay detector and every stability comparison against rounds 4, 5 and 7.22 run on the same grid as before. 7.22 already killed one stability claim that lived on 250-8000 and dissolved on 250-4000; changing the grid under a cross-arm comparison would manufacture a second.
cadence.why_a_separate_file: so no cross-arm comparison can pick up a sub-grid row by accident, and so ~18 new read-off points never enter the pool 7.16 consumes.

budget.rule: budget = 2 x the first fold-0 step at which normalised ||A||_* reaches the sharpening ceiling 10.8413
budget.why_set_membership_and_not_a_floor: 7.22 makes cross-arm contrasts by reading at a MATCHED STEP, not by clearing a threshold -- lambda=0 was read at 2000 for CORAL and 1500 for FreeMatch -- and 7.16 showed the read-off point matters enormously. A budget of 1600 is not 'comparable to FreeMatch's 1500' merely because it exceeds it. Membership of the declared set is the property that licenses a contrast; being above some number is not.
budget.why_this_could_change_before_hashing: OUTCOME-NEUTRAL for this round: the Stage-2 trajectory implies 1000, which is neither >= 1500 nor a member of {1500, 2000, 4000}, so the verdict is identical under either definition. A definition change that cannot alter the outcome it is applied to is a repair of the instrument, not a selection of the result. PROJECT.md 7.23 records this.
budget.a_match_removes_only_the_budget_confound: Head initialisation and the gamma-tuning budget still travel with every contrast (7.18) and are not addressed by reading at a matched step.

named_outcomes.normal: the budget is derived and quoted normally
named_outcomes.never_crossed: REFUSES. budget None. Stop and report.
named_outcomes.exceeds_ceiling: REFUSES. budget None. NEVER clamped to the ceiling -- a clamped budget is indistinguishable from a derived one in this JSON.
named_outcomes.no_matched_arm_budget: DOES NOT REFUSE. Fires when the rule-derived budget is not EXACTLY one of the declared arm budgets {1500, 2000, 4000}. The budget is derived and used, but the number is quoted ONLY as BNM's own-objective reading -- 'BNM read where its own objective says it is done'. All cross-arm contrasts use MATCHED READOUTS, with 4000 mandatory as the lambda=0 known-null's budget.

budget.why_declared_now: Stage 2 measured the saturation -- with C = 2 the confidence term is ~99% spent inside 1000 steps -- so a budget far below every other arm is foreseeable. Data bearing on the rule has been seen, so THE RULE DOES NOT CHANGE; only which number may be quoted against other arms, and that is fixed before the development run rather than after.
budget.stage2_preview_is_NOT_the_declaration: 1000 is what the rule returns when fed the STAGE-2 trajectory, which was sampled at 250 cadence -- so its crossing is resolved only to +/-250 and the implied budget only to +/-500. THE BUDGET IS DETERMINED BY THE DEVELOPMENT RUN'S TRAJECTORY, not by this preview. The development run's hybrid cadence resolves the crossing to +/-25 and therefore the budget to +/-50, so the declared budget may plausibly land anywhere in 750-1050. A shift from 1000 at Stage 3 is the INTENDED REFINEMENT, not a change of rule -- recorded here so it cannot read as one afterwards.
budget.why_4000: BNM's gamma=0 known-null is the lambda=0 arm at budget 4000 (7.22), so 4000 is where the control is read and therefore where the treatment must also be read.
budget.budget_status: OPEN. The rule reads a crossing that only the Stage-3 development run produces. Following the round-5 precedent for runs/dann_r5_budget.json, this stays False until a budget is derived and hashed.

disclosure_704_78.what_it_is: the round-6 analogue of lambda=0's 'three conditions fire on a healthy control': declared in advance so that seeing it on folds 1-4 is a disclosed expectation, not a discovery.
disclosure_704_78.signature: a POSITIVE nuclear gap with a NEGATIVE entropy gap is MEMORISING; both slices moving together is GENERALISING
disclosure_704_78.size_matched: 78 trained-on vs 78 held-out, drawn the same stratified way
disclosure_704_78.why_size_matching_is_not_optional: normalised ||A||_* is sqrt(B/C) at a confident state, so 704-vs-78 reads 3.00x higher at IDENTICAL behaviour; an unmatched comparison would report sqrt(B) as memorisation
disclosure_704_78.SUPPORTED: the entropy gap is negative in every read; the full signature is present in 10 of 12; magnitude is dose-responsive across the grid (+0.021 -> +0.069 -> +0.131); at the selected gamma it is absent early and emerges (-0.0085, -0.0232, +0.0410, +0.0729).
disclosure_704_78.NOT_SUPPORTED_AND_NOT_CLAIMED: any gamma-ordering. Within-arm scatter is sd ~ 0.043 against a 0.111 separation, from four autocorrelated checkpoints on one fold.
disclosure_704_78.NO_SIGN_TEST: the 12 reads are 3 arms x 4 checkpoints and are autocorrelated within arm, so the effective unit is the ARM and n = 3. Reported descriptively -- 'consistent in sign across all three gamma and all four checkpoints' -- with NO p-value and NO confidence interval.
disclosure_704_78.PREDICTED_ON_FOLDS_1_4: the memorising signature PERSISTS: entropy gap negative and nuclear gap positive at the majority of full-grid checkpoints on each of folds 1-4, at magnitudes comparable to the selected gamma's fold-0 values (nuclear gap of order +0.02 to +0.08 on a 6.245 ceiling, i.e. ~0.3-1.3%).
disclosure_704_78.PREDICTION_REASONING: 7.12 measured 14.8M parameters memorising these same 782 target images on 4/4 confirmatory folds, and BNM's confidence term (~70% of its pull, 7.20) rewards confident predictions on exactly those images. The trained-on slice is inside that memorised set and the held-out 78 are not, so the gap is expected wherever the memorisation is. Fold 0 is one fold and the selected gamma is the weakest of the three, so folds 1-4 at the same gamma are the like-for-like test.
disclosure_704_78.SCORED_EITHER_WAY: this prediction is scored after folds 1-4, not revised. A negative result is reported as a failed prediction and is informative about BNM, not about the diagnostic.

FALSIFIER.tolerated: ONE fold near zero or slightly negative. Within-arm scatter is sd ~ 0.043, so a single off-sign fold is noise, not falsification.
FALSIFIER.falsified_by_sign: consistently negative gaps across folds -- i.e. the memorising signature absent or reversed on the majority of folds 1-4.
FALSIFIER.falsified_by_magnitude: nuclear gaps above ~0.15. A gap that large is not the mechanism described; it would indicate something other than the 7.12 memorisation being read.
FALSIFIER.why_a_falsifier_is_stated: a prediction with no stated failure condition scores itself: any outcome can be narrated as consistent with it after the fact.

TWO_INDEPENDENT_PREDICTIONS_RECORDED.note: an independent prediction was written against this one BEFORE folds 1-4 ran. Both are recorded, with the disagreement, because a forecast that survives having been contradicted in advance is worth more than one nobody challenged. THE REGISTERED PREDICTION STANDS -- and it stands ON THE MERITS, not merely because it was written first. The three reasons are recorded below because the decision went AGAINST the better-informed bound, which is the kind of choice that looks arbitrary later unless its reasoning is written down now.

why_the_registered_bound_is_the_better_o.1_independence: +0.04 was derived FROM fold 0 reaching +0.0729 at step 1000 -- one fold, four autocorrelated checkpoints, within-arm sd 0.043. A lower bound fitted that closely to a single observed trajectory is halfway to a postdiction and inherits every bit of that trajectory's noise. +0.02 was set BEFORE the crossover was seen, so it is independent of the thing it predicts. That makes it the more informative forecast even though it is the vaguer one.
why_the_registered_bound_is_the_better_o.2_different_reference_class_MEASURED_NOT: each of folds 1-4 has a different target composition, so fold 0's gap magnitude is not automatically the right point estimate for them. MEASURED FROM data/splits/splits.json rather than assumed: there are 489 distinct real lenses split into five DISJOINT test sets (98/98/98/98/97), and each fold's target pool is all 489 minus its own test set (391/391/391/391/392). So fold 0's target pool is a strict SUBSET of the union of folds 1-4's (489), not equal to it, and it shares 293 of its 391 images -- 74.9% -- with each of folds 1-4 individually.
why_the_registered_bound_is_the_better_o.2b_WHAT_THAT_OVERLAP_DOES_TO_THIS_ARGUME: IT WEAKENS IT, and that is recorded rather than left out. At 74.9% shared images fold 0 IS partly informative about folds 1-4, so 'tuned to the wrong reference' overstates it: the reference is substantially the same, differing by ~25% of the pool. The honest form is that fold 0 is a correlated but not interchangeable draw. Reasons 1 and 3 do not depend on this and are unaffected; they are the load-bearing ones.
why_the_registered_bound_is_the_better_o.2c_THE_OVERLAP_ALSO_BEARS_ON_THE_FALSIFI: because folds 1-4 share ~75% of their target images with each other as well, their gaps are NOT independent draws. Cross-fold scatter should therefore be SMALLER than independent sampling would imply, which makes the 'one fold near zero is tolerated' allowance more generous than it first looks -- a genuinely off-sign fold under this much sharing is more surprising, not less. The tolerance is kept as declared; this note exists so that if exactly one fold does come back off-sign, the reading is made with the correlation in view rather than discovered afterwards.
why_the_registered_bound_is_the_better_o.3_a_bound_noise_alone_can_break_is_not_t: with within-arm sd ~ 0.043, a true value sitting AT a lower bound of +0.04 can be carried to zero or below by ordinary fold scatter -- the bound would be falsified by noise rather than by the mechanism being wrong. The wider [0.02, 0.08] window is robust to one-sd scatter in a way [0.04, 0.08] is not.
why_the_registered_bound_is_the_better_o.what_this_costs: the registered bound is weaker: it is satisfied by outcomes the independent one would call failures. That cost is accepted deliberately -- a prediction that only survives because it was fitted to the one trajectory available is not worth more for being narrower.

TWO_INDEPENDENT_PREDICTIONS_RECORDED.registered_prediction_written_first: nuclear gap of order +0.02 to +0.08 on a 6.245 ceiling (~0.3-1.3%), sign positive with entropy gap negative, at the majority of full-grid checkpoints on each of folds 1-4.
TWO_INDEPENDENT_PREDICTIONS_RECORDED.independent_prediction: sign: positive nuclear gap, negative entropy gap, on ALL FOUR folds. magnitude: roughly +0.04 to +0.08 at a budget near 1000, from fold 0's crossover around steps 500-750 reaching +0.0729 by 1000.
TWO_INDEPENDENT_PREDICTIONS_RECORDED.where_they_disagree: the LOWER BOUND on magnitude: +0.02 (registered) vs +0.04 (independent). The registered prediction is the more permissive, so an outcome in [0.02, 0.04) confirms it and fails the independent one. The upper bound (+0.08), the sign, the falsifier and the mechanism are agreed.
TWO_INDEPENDENT_PREDICTIONS_RECORDED.how_this_is_scored: both are scored against the same folds 1-4 result. If the outcome lands in [0.02, 0.04) that is reported explicitly as the registered prediction surviving where the independent one did not, and vice versa above 0.08. THE DISAGREEMENT IS DELIBERATELY LEFT LIVE: it was not collapsed to a single number before the data arrived, because the [0.02, 0.04) window is the genuinely diagnostic one and a quiet convergence beforehand would have destroyed the only place where the two forecasts can be told apart.

predictions_from_7_20.prediction_1_decay_direction: Delta POSITIVE (late-is-worse), point estimate nearer CORAL's +0.0278 than FreeMatch's +0.0951, and NOT distinguishable from zero at cap 8000.
predictions_from_7_20.prediction_1_why_ambiguous: 7.14's rule 'no pseudo-label loop => no confirmation-bias decay' does not resolve BNM: it has no pseudo-label loop (like CORAL) but does have a confidence-sharpening loop (like FreeMatch). The ambiguity is why this is pre-registered rather than assumed.
predictions_from_7_20.prediction_2_collapse: target predicted-positive fraction DRIFTS UPWARD from 0.2292 toward ~0.5, and does NOT collapse to 0 or 1.
predictions_from_7_20.prediction_2_stage2_status: CONSISTENT SO FAR on fold 0 development only: end-of-run predicted-positive fraction was 0.2617 / 0.3477 / 0.4062 across the grid, upward from 0.2292 and monotone in gamma, with no collapse. This is NOT the confirmatory scoring of the prediction, which happens on folds 1-4.

collapse_band.floor_status: GATES -- an arm below it does not pass selection
collapse_band.ceiling_status: ADVISORY ONLY. It logs and ESCALATES in the result, and never selects. A detector that can only trigger on catastrophe is worse than an advisory one that triggers on drift.
collapse_band.the_standing_rule: the band must not fire at step 0. Earned three times: round 5's abort3b, condition 4, and the 0.25-0.75 absolute band this one replaces.

conditions.arming: ADVISORY, NEVER ABORTING, on every fold.
conditions.why: round 5's abort3b fired on all four confirmatory folds, and three conditions fire on a healthy lambda=0 control. A detector that fires on healthy runs must not be allowed to end them.
conditions.derived_from_control_arm_note: anything re-specified from a control arm is labelled here and is NOT pre-registration.

step0_gate.what_it_asserts: at step 0 the arm reproduces Baseline A's per-fold TPR and AUROC exactly -- |diff| = 0.0 -- because before any optimiser step the model IS Baseline A. A non-zero diff means the arm is not starting where it claims to.

reporting.primary_metric: TPR@FPR=1e-3, interpolated, drop_intermediate=False, ALWAYS a rate, never counts
reporting.interval: paired t-interval on 4 differences, df=3. NOT a bootstrap: at n=4 a bootstrap draws from a 4^4=256 lattice.
reporting.pooling: INVALID for per-fold-model arms. Per-fold ROC curves only.
reporting.morphology: TWO instruments ~0.34 apart: the trained-head AUROC (~0.57) and the frozen-feature probe (~0.92). 7.19: never quote one as the other. Condition 3 reads the FROZEN PROBE.
reporting.undefined_values: report as n/a with NO CI
reporting.decay_detector: Task-A, UNMODIFIED: same definition, same shared-resample paired bootstrap, B=5000, seed 0, on the 250-grid points ONLY, so it is comparable to CORAL's +0.0278 and FreeMatch's +0.0951.
reporting.nothing_from_fold_0: Nothing about ranking is concluded from fold 0.
